service_alerts.subject: Atlanta Scheduled Maintenance (Critical) - 2026-11-12

entries.message:
Event Type: Network Upgrade

We are performing system changes in the Atlanta location during the following scheduled maintenance window. 

Start Time: 2026-11-12 05:00:00 UTC
End Time: 2026-11-12 09:00:00 UTC

We schedule higher impact maintenance events during off-peak times to maintain our ideal hosting environment. Our engineers make every effort to minimize system impact; however, Atlanta instances may be unreachable from the internet for some of the scheduled maintenance window as we perform a critical network topology change. While the work is scheduled to last several hours, we are diligently preparing the procedure so that we can reasonably expect any downtime incurred to be measured in seconds.

service_alerts.subject: Scheduled Maintenance: VKE Control Plane Upgrades

entries.message:
We will be performing software updates on Vultr Kubernetes Engine (VKE) control planes as part of our ongoing effort to maintain a reliable and secure hosting environment.

Start: 2026-11-16 16:00:00 UTC
End:   2026-11-16 19:00:00 UTC

What to expect:
- Your cluster's control plane will be upgraded at some point during this window. The exact time for each cluster is not scheduled in advance and cannot be provided.
- Each control plane will be unavailable for less than five minutes. During that brief period, the Kubernetes API and cluster management operations, including deployments and scaling, will be temporarily unavailable.
- Existing workloads will continue to run. Worker nodes are not rebooted and no pods are restarted. Load balancers, block storage, and other attached resources are unaffected.
- CI/CD and GitOps tools may report transient errors during the window and will retry automatically.


What you need to do: 
No action is required. If you have time-sensitive deployments planned, we recommend avoiding this window.

We will publish updates at https://status.vultr.com/ when the maintenance begins and when it completes. If you experience any issues after the window closes, please contact Support.

service_alerts.subject: Singapore Network Outage

entries.message:
We are aware of an issue affecting services in our Singapore location. The cause is due to inclement weather involving Typhoon Dujuan which resulted in a global sub-sea cable cut. 
Our engineers will continue to monitor the status of this outage until it is resolved.
